posts.title: An incomplete case against generative AI
posts.description: The following is a terse list of harms caused by generative AI. From here on, the term “AI” is used as shorthand for generative AI, particularly LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude, as well as generative image and video models. posts.title: Why do people say AI codegen has improved?
posts.description: Since at least 2023, there’s been a persistent trend of people saying that “AI code generation is much better now than it was six months ago.” There are multiple possible reasons why someone might say this, and a neutral observer should consider all of them. posts.title: Four essential laws of programming
posts.description: There are two distinct kinds of software: Software as a tool is designed to make a given task faster, simpler, safer, cheaper, or more reliable. Software as a financial asset is designed grow the wealth of its investors. Much as it seems like these goals should be aligned, all real-world evidence points to them being incompatible.
